A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CRANE work. Their main text, equations, three figures, five tables, and complete appendices are readable and can be matched reliably despite layout changes.

before.justification: V2 reports original GSM-Symbolic and FOLIO experiments, including accuracy, syntactic validity, token counts, few-shot ablations, and sampling comparisons.

after.justification: V4 retains these original empirical results and adds GSM-Symbolic evaluations using three larger model backbones.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm 1 retain the same delimiter-triggered switching between unconstrained reasoning and constrained generation. The decoder interfaces and appendix grammars are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate symbolic-expression generation on GSM-Symbolic and natural-language-to-FOL translation on FOLIO. The added model backbones introduce no new dataset, task, or input scenario.

E2.justification: GSM-Symbolic retains unconstrained generation with and without CoT and IterGen-constrained generation; FOLIO retains unconstrained CoT and SynCode-constrained generation. The same comparator methods are evaluated with the added backbones, and appendix sampling comparators are unchanged.

E3.justification: Section 5 extends GSM-Symbolic evaluation from six backbones to nine by adding Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B, and QwQ-32B. The stated eight-shot, greedy-decoding, 600-new-token protocol remains unchanged, as do existing FOLIO and ablation settings.

E4.justification: Figure 3 and Table 3 retain the same two-, four-, and eight-shot ablation. The GSM-Symbolic case study, sampling analysis, and comparisons in Appendix C.3–C.4 and Tables 4–5 are unchanged.

E5.justification: The sampling appendices retain three samples and pass@1/2/3 reporting. V4 introduces no new run or seed information, uncertainty estimates, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Table 1 adds accuracy, parsing, and token results for three larger backbones. CRANE versus unconstrained CoT accuracy is 45% versus 42% for Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct, 38% versus 32% for DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B, and 46% versus 43% for QwQ-32B. These are newly reported comparisons; the original six-model results and all entries in Tables 2–5 remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, finite-language expressivity bound, Turing-machine simulation result, and augmented-grammar construction are unchanged. Appendices A–C retain the same assumptions, derivations, and proofs.

C1.justification: Both versions claim that restrictive grammars can reduce expressivity, suitable grammar augmentation preserves reasoning, and CRANE improves empirical accuracy by up to ten percentage points. The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain these claims without substantive strengthening or narrowing.

C2.justification: The reasoning mechanism, accuracy-versus-syntax discussion, and sampling accuracy-versus-token interpretation remain unchanged. Both versions state the finite-output-language limitation of Proposition 3.1 and CRANE's requirement for access to model logits.

D1.justification: V4 adds an explicit code-availability statement and CRANE repository link in the abstract, absent from v2. Existing hardware, software, prompts, grammars, and implementation descriptions are retained.

R1.justification: V4 adds Team (2025), 'QwQ-32B: Embracing the power of reinforcement learning,' to cite the newly evaluated model. Section 6's positioning relative to constrained decoding and transformer expressivity research remains unchanged.

P1.justification: Limited editorial changes include correcting 'dentone' to 'denote,' updating the model list, and replacing the preliminary-review notice with ICML 2025 proceedings information. The overall prose, terminology, and section order are retained.

P2.justification: Table 1 expands from six to nine model blocks. Tables 1 and 2 move from pages combining tables and prose to separate pages after the conclusion, and Figure 3 moves earlier. All three figure images are identical, and table columns and appendix displays are retained.

improvement.justification: The added Table 1 comparisons consistently favor CRANE on 14B and 32B backbones, extending empirical support beyond v2's smaller-model evaluations on GSM-Symbolic. The explicit code pointer also improves access information. These are limited gains: task coverage, theory, and uncertainty reporting remain unchanged, while moving the main tables away from their discussion slightly reduces reading convenience.
